title: What would a clippy config and a fmt and clippy CI job look like for nail?
body:
nail has no `clippy.toml` and no `[workspace.lints]` table. `.github/workflows/release.yml` is the only workflow, and it runs neither `cargo fmt --check` nor `cargo clippy`. Jack has not set either up before and wants to see one in practice before committing to it.

## Proposal

Show on this repository what each piece looks like:

- a `clippy.toml`, or a `[workspace.lints]` table in `Cargo.toml`
- a workflow step that runs `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy` on push
- a failing CI run, to see what a contributor would meet
